rootCause.symptom: longer bar (60m, 240m) research experiments returned SKIPPED with reason SKIPPED_DATASET_MANIFEST_VOLUME_MISSING and statusProjection().experimentCount stayed 0 while the 1m orchestrator completed 10 experiments
rootCause.location: apps/cloud/src/researchExperimentRunner.ts canonical-dataset guard reads persisted candles through the AggregatedResearchCandleSource port
rootCause.cause: AggregatedResearchCandleSource.flush() built longer bars with no volume field at all, so candle.volume == null was always true for aggregated bars; for 1m the ratio === 1 path short-circuits to the raw store, which does carry volume, which is why only longer bars skipped
rootCause.whyItSurfacedNow: the in-flight manifest binding makes ports.datasetManifest non-null, which is the precondition for the guard to run at all

fix.statement: aggregated longer-bar candles now carry real summed traded volume when every 1m constituent has one, and omit the field entirely (fail closed) when any constituent lacks it, so a volume-less dataset can never be verified as canonical

provenanceChangeNote.change: the mixed observation provenance guard now rejects mixed source and sourceFingerprint (fail closed) while no longer requiring all observations to share one evidenceFingerprintSha256
provenanceChangeNote.rationale: a canonical dataset materialized from several evidence receipts legitimately carries per-observation evidence fingerprints; requiring a single value made multi-receipt materialization impossible while the data source identity guard stayed strict
provenanceChangeNote.baseline: current protected main carries no mixed-provenance guard in this function at all, so the resulting state on this branch is stricter than main, not weaker
